en.html:
Both men stiffened as if iron needles had been driven into their spines, then collapsed.

Behind them stood the ruler of Horigoe, slightly sooty.

Unharmed, as perhaps I ought to have expected. Somehow I had been sure from the beginning that she had not died in the explosion.

How she had escaped it, I could not begin to imagine.

瞬間、脊椎に鉄針でも打ち込まれたかのように身を
強張らせて、二人の男が<ruby>頽<rt>くずお</rt></ruby>れる。

　心持ち<ruby>煤<rt>すす</rt></ruby>けた堀越公方が、その後方に立っていた。

　やはりと言うべきか、無事だったようだ。
　何とはなし、俺は彼女が爆死を遂げてなどいない事
に最初から確信があった――どうやって死地を逃れた
のか、その方法はまるで想像がつかないのだが。

Chachamaru"They are a kind of religious group."

en.html:
Kageaki"Opposing the shogunate on some religious grounds?"
Chachamaru"More like they made overthrowing it their religion... Or it turned into one. Started out fairly ordinary, then became infatuated with a certain hero."
Chachamaru"Little by little, hero becomes god. Whatever the hero does is right. They start copying it also. Congratulations, now they're extremists near the top of the blacklist."
Kageaki"............"
Chachamaru"They call themselves the Meteor Gang. The idol they've decided to worship, entirely on their own—naturally, today's great mass killer."
Chachamaru"Silver Star. Demon king among humans."
